summary: Copel filed a Brazilian 6-K reporting that its Board of Directors unanimously approved delisting its shares from Latibex, the Madrid-based exchange for Latin American equities, on September 17, 2026, following a favorable Executive Board recommendation at its 2,669th Meeting on September 10, 2026. No price, consideration, stake, or premium is stated; the move is a voluntary exchange withdrawal rather than a US-style SEC Form 25 delisting, leaving B3 and NYSE listings intact. The Board also approved a revised IT and cybersecurity policy including AI guidelines. Watch for effective withdrawal timing and any ADR market impact.
